steps.text: Closing the jaws produced contact, but the block slipped behind during a fast diagonal move. I’m replaying the same approach and advancing in small increments so friction can carry the block more reliably.

from mw_runtime import Session
s=Session(); s.move([0.0213,0.632,0.028],gripper=-1,steps=45); s.step([0,0,0,1]); s.step([0,0,0,1]); s.move([0.0213,0.70,0.028],gripper=1,steps=20)
for i in range(160):
    s.step([0.04,0.13,0,1])
    if i in (19,39,59,79,99,119,139,159):
        o=s.observe(); print(i+1,'tcp',o['tcp'].round(3),'obj',o['bodies']['obj']['position'].round(3),'success',s.result()['success'])
    if s.result()['success']: break
print('FINAL',s.result()); s.save('/app/output/trajectory.npz')
PY
